neighbours.label: the piece after 'Ho' spelling 'oar' in Hoare, Hoar, hoary and hoarfrost (not hoarse or hoard)
fire: The proof relies on a Hoare triple and a loop invariant.
Cyclist Mathieu Hoareau won the stage near Lyon.
At the conference, analyst Jim Hoar gave the keynote.
The ancient oak stood beside a hoary stone wall.
That is a hoary old joke about lawyers.
At dawn the meadow glittered with hoarfrost.
The wizard stroked his hoary beard and sighed.
See Hoare's history of the county for details.
quiet: The proof relies on a Turing machine and a loop invariant.
Cyclist Mathieu Hopper won the stage near Lyon.
At the conference, analyst Jim Hobbs gave the keynote.
The ancient oak stood beside a mossy stone wall.
That is a tired old joke about lawyers.
At dawn the singer was hoarse from the concert.
The miser stroked his hoard of coins and sighed.

notes: Very sparse: only 7 scan tokens reach 0.3 of max, nearly all of them Hoare or hoary. In probes, hoarse and hoard stayed under 0.03. Weak activations spread to other name pieces (iot, ERO, uer) and other scripts.
